name: kettlebell overhand grip swing
description: A kettlebell swing with an overhand grip that builds explosive hip power and a strong posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with an overhand grip.
Hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat.
